metadata.target_conclusion: There is more than one gunman involved in the hostage-taking at the Sydney cafe

posts.text: Witnesses report multiple gunshots and explosions at a cafe during a siege. #Siege #Gunfire
At 2 PM, a loud explosion and gunshots near the cafe entrance. Authorities suspect additional gunmen. #Suspicion #Emergency
At 6 PM, another round of gunfire from inside the cafe. Law enforcement believes coordinated activity. #MultipleShooters #Investigation
Suspect's erratic behavior and complex routes raise questions about assistance. Video shows coordination with unseen individuals. #EvasiveBehavior #CoordinatedActions
Law enforcement continues to investigate, but mounting evidence suggests multiple gunmen. Could this be a coordinated attack? #MultipleGunmen #OngoingInvestigation
Police have not found concrete evidence yet, but the complexity of the siege hints at a larger operation. Speculation grows. #ComplexOperation #Speculation
